findings.evidence: Trace.lean:322-326 vs SturmBound.lean:61-66; mathlib/Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/Basic.lean:77,96,115. Grep for `bdd_at_cusps` across TauCeti shows only these two derivations of `IsBoundedAtImInfty f` from the integer cusp width; no pre-existing lemma covers it.
findings.fix: State it once in Trace.lean's `Analytic` section (`[ModularFormClass F 𝒢 k]`, `[𝒢.IsFiniteRelIndex 𝒮ℒ]` are already in scope), e.g. `public lemma isBoundedAtImInfty_of_isFiniteRelIndex : IsBoundedAtImInfty f`, use it for `hf_bdd`, and delete SturmBound.lean:61-66, passing it at line 80. `𝒢` occurs in the included instance binder `[ModularFormClass F 𝒢 k]` (which mentions the used variable `F`), so it can stay implicit and is fixed at both call sites by `ModularFormClass (ModularForm 𝒢 k) 𝒢 k`; if inference does fail there, an explicit `𝒢` at two call sites is still preferable to two copies of the proof — SturmBound already writes `(𝒢 := 𝒢)` at lines 58 and 64. Same fix removes the third copy of `(by exact_mod_cast Subgroup.integerCuspWidth_pos (𝒢 := 𝒢) : (0:ℝ) < _)` (SturmBound.lean:58, 64; Trace.lean:324), which a one-line real-valued positivity lemma next to `Subgroup.integerCuspWidth_pos` (Cusps.lean:148) would absorb.
findings.issue: `hf_bdd` here (`isBoundedAt_infty_iff.mp <| ModularFormClass.bdd_at_cusps f <| isCusp_of_mem_strictPeriods _ integerCuspWidth_mem_strictPeriods`) is the same proof as the new private `isBoundedAtImInfty_of_finiteRelIndex` at SturmBound.lean:61-66, which spells it `f.bdd_at_cusps'`. Mathlib Basic.lean:115 (`bdd_at_cusps := ModularForm.bdd_at_cusps'`) makes the two literally the same field, so the PR introduces a near-clone rather than the shared helper its description claims.

summary: The new material is not a duplicate of anything in Mathlib or TauCeti, but the PR ships the boundedness derivation twice: inline in `qExpansion_one_norm_order_eq` and as the new private helper in `SturmBound.lean`. Factor it into one lemma.
